# Tom Brier

> Tom Brier (born October 3, 1971, Oakdale, California) is an American ragtime pianist and composer with more than 200 piano compositions, including the modern ragtime standard "Razor Blades" (1994). He released his first album, Rising Star, in 1994 and received the Scott Joplin International Ragtime Foundation's Ragtime Outstanding Achievement Award in 2023. A 2016 car accident ended his performing career.
